Proper airflow range (temperature split)

Cooling mode, running at least 15 minutes with the doors closed. Measure in the return close to the unit and in the supply plenum just past the coil (out of sight of any heat strips).

A bigger split means more total heat (sensible + latent) the system has to reject — pairs with the Required Airflow tab's sensible-only numbers.

Sends indoor wet bulb & outdoor dry bulb straight into the SH/SC tab's piston superheat target.

Wet bulb: Stull (2011) approximation. Dew point: Magnus-Tetens. Both are within about ±1 °F for typical HVAC conditions (RH 5–99%).

Pressures in psig. Values below 0 psig shown in inHg vacuum. Blends: use bubble (liquid) for subcool, dew (vapor) for superheat.

🚨 Emergencies

  • Smell gas: no switches, phones or flames inside. Get everyone out, shut the gas at the meter if safe, call the gas utility / 911 from outside.
  • CO 70 ppm or more: everyone out and call 911. 36–69 ppm: ventilate and shut off sources. 9–35 ppm: tell the customer and ventilate.
  • Electric shock: don't touch the person until the power is off. Call 911; start CPR / use an AED if trained.
  • Refrigerant on skin or eyes: get to fresh air; warm (not hot) water on skin — don't rub; flush eyes 15 minutes; get medical help.
  • Heat stroke (confusion, hot dry skin, collapse): call 911 and cool them down right away.
  • Burns: cool running water for 10+ minutes; get help for large or deep burns.

A guide, not a substitute for the manufacturer's instructions. Lock out power before touching wiring; line-voltage tests are for qualified techs.

Evaporator TD

TD = box air temperature − saturated suction temperature. Measure with the box near setpoint and the coil clear of frost.

Evaporator TD
—
Sat. suction
—
Usual TD
—

Blends use the dew point. R-448A and R-449A glide about 8–10 °F, and some unit cooler makers rate TD on the midpoint (about 4–5 °F below dew), which reads a larger TD. The unit cooler's rated TD comes first; high-humidity boxes (produce, meat) run lower TDs.

Freeze-cycle check

Look up the expected freeze time on the machine's chart for today's air and water temperatures, then time a full freeze and harvest.

⚠️ Walk-ins must open from the inside — check the interior release. R-290 and R-600a units are flammable: no open flame or brazing until the system is recovered and purged per the maker. Follow EPA Section 608 and the manufacturer's instructions.
